exposure: Placental allograft layer composition (Dual Layer, Full Thickness, Amnion-Intermediate-Chorion-Amnion (ACA))
outcome: Extracellular Matrix (ECM) profiles (thickness, collagen, elastin, proteoglycans, hyaluronic acid)
Growth factor profiles (ANG-2, EGF, PDGF-AA, VEGF)
cohort: The study subjects were human placental-derived allografts configured into three distinct layer compositions: Dual Layer, Full Thickness, and a novel four-layer (ACA) allograft.
finding: The structural and biochemical properties of placental-derived allografts, including thickness, ECM components, and growth factors, are significantly dependent on their layer composition.
